content.body:
## Pollinator Garden Tour

Discover the beauty and impact of pollinator-friendly gardening! Join us for a self-guided tour of home gardens across Arvada that have been designed to support pollinators.

### Event Details

- **Date:** Saturday, June 27, 2026
- **Time:** More details to come.
- **No registration required.**

Each stop on the tour offers inspiration and ideas for how you can make your own outdoor space a haven for pollinators. The tour begins at Majestic View Nature Center, where participants can pick up a tour map and garden details before heading out to explore.

Whether you're a seasoned gardener or just curious, this event is a great way to connect with nature, neighbors, and local conservation efforts. Can't wait to see you there!

Interested in being a host? [Fill out an interest form here](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf5BCu6_Szp46MCX6GBDcFcjK9l5_qiRlZ7WQyVTBBp0vA-3g/viewform?usp=dialog) before May 31.
